PSV1-BTC_H1-UPTREND-BREAKOUT_CONT.mechanism: forced-counterparty anatomy of BTC markup legs: shorts are stopped/liquidated into standing highs and late momentum chasers lift offers; continuation after a 20d-high breakout is supplied by these forced buyers, and the effect survives costs because episodes are sparse (few round trips/yr) and multi-day.
PSV1-BTC_H1-UPTREND-BREAKOUT_CONT.observable: PIT: close vs trailing 480-bar high of highs (Donchian-20d) on the H1 UTC grid, gated by the cell's frozen phase rule state UPTREND
PSV1-BTC_H1-UPTREND-BREAKOUT_CONT.entry: state==UPTREND AND close > max(high, previous 480 bars)
PSV1-BTC_H1-UPTREND-BREAKOUT_CONT.exit: STOP: close < min(low, trailing 240 bars) [risk stop, pre-min-hold allowed]; gate-off exit: state leaves UPTREND after min-hold; fold-end force-flat
PSV1-BTC_H1-UPTREND-BREAKOUT_CONT.holding: min hold 24 bars (churn law); max hold unbounded (structure-exited)
PSV1-BTC_H1-UPTREND-BREAKOUT_CONT.stop_policy: the 240-bar-low close IS the stop (structure stop); no separate ATR stop
PSV1-BTC_H1-UPTREND-BREAKOUT_CONT.execution: decision at bar close; fill at NEXT bar open; no mid-bar fills
PSV1-BTC_H1-UPTREND-BREAKOUT_CONT.churn_law: min-dwell 24 bars == phase-rule transition buffer; same-direction label noise produces zero fills (no-op law, engine-structurally-enforced)
PSV1-BTC_H1-UPTREND-BREAKOUT_CONT.capacity: BTCUSDT-PERP is the deepest crypto venue; hourly decisions with multi-day holds at 1.0 book fraction are negligible vs top-of-book depth; turnover = entries/yr x 2 sides (see ceiling.json)

PSV1-BTC_H1-ACC-FLOOR_PROVISION.mechanism: at range floors after declines, forced sellers (margin-stressed longs, redemption flows, impatient holders) hit thin books; patient accumulation provides the other side and inventory is held through the range until markup; effect survives costs because entries are sparse deep-in-range events with multi-week holds.

PSV1-BTC_H1-ACC-FLOOR_PROVISION.capacity: sparse floor entries, multi-week holds; turnover counts in ceiling.json
